        if len(prices) < 2:

        X = np.array([prices[:-1]])
        Y = np.array([prices[-1]])
        self._model.fit(X, Y)
        # Scale the latest prices using the same scaler to get the z-score.
        scaled_prices = self._scaler.transform([prices])
